created = []
updated = []
for row in (doc.block_numbers or []):
    pps = doc.plants_per_sqm or 0
    area = row.block_area or 0
    pc = int(round(area * pps))
    pdate = row.planting_date or doc.planting_date
    exists = frappe.db.exists({'doctype': 'Block', 'greenhouse': doc.greenhouse, 'block': row.block_no})
    if exists:
        b = frappe.get_doc('Block', {'greenhouse': doc.greenhouse, 'block': row.block_no})
        b.farm = doc.farm
        b.variety = row.variety_grown
        b.block_length = row.block_length
        b.block_width = row.block_width
        b.block_area = area
        b.total_variety_area = doc.total_beds_area
        b.plant_count = pc
        b.planting_date = pdate
        b.save(ignore_permissions=True)
        updated.append(str(row.block_no))
    else:
        b = frappe.get_doc({'doctype': 'Block', 'greenhouse': doc.greenhouse, 'block': row.block_no, 'farm': doc.farm, 'variety': row.variety_grown, 'block_length': row.block_length, 'block_width': row.block_width, 'block_area': area, 'total_variety_area': doc.total_beds_area, 'plant_count': pc, 'planting_date': pdate})
        b.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        created.append(str(row.block_no))
if created or updated:
    frappe.msgprint('Blocks created: ' + str(len(created)) + ', updated: ' + str(len(updated)), indicator='green')
name: Block Autocreation
